summary: Approved as readable, behavior-validated unmatched C++; zero matching-source byte credit.
reason: Source control flow, x86 layout, calling convention, overflow ordering, self-prepend and helper side effects agree with the original assembly. Independently rebuilt and ran full differential tests with fixed helper placement, and verified the oracle’s 205 bytes against Game.exe. Tests cover storage boundaries, relocation/refusal, embedded NULs, overflow and complete object/buffer changes. Native Windows evidence compiles the actual implementation. External allocator/CRT behavior and exception unwinding remain documented limitations; sampled validation does not establish all-input equivalence.
